fieldDescription: Enables access to D-MOD service centers in [size 6 or higher markets].
Multiplies the base cost for adding a selected d-mod to a ship. This does not change how the cost scales with additional d-mods.
Adding a selected d-mod also [applies the 'unrestorable' tag] to the ship, preventing any d-mod removal from either dockyard restoration or the Hull Restoration skill.
Enables [all 'dmod'-tagged hullmods] to appear as options, with [no specific restrictions], when adding selected d-mods for a ship.
Multiplies the base cost for removing a selected s-mod from a ship.

Removing at least the [base maximum number of s-mods] also [removes the 'unrestorable' tag] from the selected ship. The base maximum number of s-mods is specified in "maxPermanentHullmods" of Starsector's settings.json.
Adds the option of fully-automating a selected ship while visiting a D-MOD service center, but [only if you have discovered and defeated a certain defender fleet].
Multiplies the base cost for automating a ship.
Automating a ship also [applies the 'unrestorable' tag] to the ship. The dialogue remains [unaffected] if this option is disabled.
Automating a ship also [applies the 'no_auto_penalty' tag] to the ship.
